headline: Flutterwave Scraps Cyprus Acquisition After Central Bank Objection
summary: Flutterwave’s British subsidiary wrote off its entire investment in Cyprus-registered payment provider Netinfopay Ltd following an objection from the Central Bank.
why: Flutterwave is a major African fintech enterprise; cross-border expansion hurdles highlight regulatory compliance challenges facing high-growth financial technology firms.

impacts.name: Flutterwave
impacts.why: Abandoned acquisition and asset write-off following regulatory intervention.
